title: Structural Insights into the Mechanisms Behind Avian Structural Coloration
content: Photonic structures within avians interact with light, producing structural colors through their characteristics. To explain the distinctive and vivid hues of bird feathers, a comprehensive understanding of how differences in properties of photonic structure influence feather color is necessary. Since the photonic structure of feathers is tens to hundreds of nanometers in size, electron microscopy is usually used to observe and analyze their properties [1-4]. However, 2D analysis is not sufficient to fully analyze the optical effects of 3D natural structures, and 3D structural analysis is required for more accurate analysis. This study examines how the photonic structures within avian feathers generate color through 2D and 3D structural analysis.
